## Proposal Summary
A clear and concise summary of the proposed feature or enhancement.

## Motivation & Use Case
Why is this feature needed? Which humanitarian aid programme or stakeholder benefits?

## Specification Impact
- [ ] Modifies `docs/protocol.md`
- [ ] Modifies `docs/threat-model.md`
- [ ] Adds / alters public contract entry points
- [ ] Changes on-chain events or error codes

## Downstream Impact
- How does this affect `cygnus-sdk` (TypeScript bindings)?
- How does this affect `cygnus-app` (UI / Dashboard)?

## Implementation Ideas
Any specific architectural approaches or considerations for Soroban storage footprint.
